$comment: DTM 2018 changes over the era base (bases/dtm-era4, tuned on 2013). Since 2017 every race has its own qualifying session, which the game can only run as one open session. The top three in qualifying scored 3-2-1 points; the game can only give pole a single point (wish list B8). The game week holds one race, so each round is two weeks (gen.json races_per_round, wish list A1 and A4). One dry slick compound since 2017, so the two-compound rule is off (data/tyremodel.json keeps the soft as a copy of the hard, as in 2012).
